reviewer_notes: percentage values from 69.5 to 70.5 are correct
model_answer: The ACC (%) value for the "FT" model at a co-occurrence number of 10^2 is approximately 70%. This can be determined by locating the point on the blue line (representing "FT") that corresponds to 10^2 on the x-axis and reading the corresponding value on the y-axis.
